theme: one music family: low bowed cello and string drone, sparse felt piano, a soft ticking pulse
instrumental, sits quietly under a speaking voice

registers.The price: MUS-OFFER held back under the price

sections.name: The sequence
styles: low sustained drone, slow ticking pulse, sparse felt piano
rising a step with each revelation

sections.name: The band
styles: a repeating soft piano arpeggio over the drone
clean and curious, minor or modal

sections.name: The strap
styles: the drone lifts into the first warm chord
the pulse opens into gentle movement

sections.name: Proof
styles: lifted, strings and piano moving forward

sections.name: Try it
styles: a little fuller and more forward

sections.name: The price
styles: MUS-OFFER held back under the price
the same pulse, thinner, so the words carry

sections.name: Send it on
styles: plays at level to the end
only the last held chord fades in the final two seconds
